jobs.name: Release image boot smoke (isolated compose project)

steps.name: Set up job
checkout
setup node (for the S3 round-trip client only)
install deps (minio client for storage round-trip)
docker environment evidence
compute expected migration count (from the checkout)
build api + web images (real Dockerfiles)
inspect required runtime assets inside the final API image
generate ephemeral stack secrets (masked, never printed)
start the fresh stack (postgres+redis+api+web, no minio)
wait for health (api summary, live, ready, web /login, same-origin proxy)
verify migrations applied + runtime database identity (real evidence)
logs must contain no credentials or connection secrets (exact-value scan)
teardown main stack (task resources only)
negative test — incomplete production config must refuse to boot (fail-closed)
attachment storage round-trip (verified S3-compatible service or BLOCKED)
cleanup (only this task's projects and probe container)
Post setup node (for the S3 round-trip client only)
Post checkout
Complete job
